$comment: Arena registry: one entry per stakeable token. issuer says which official API publishes its
real mainnet mint (prestocks: prestocks.com/api/prestocks; xstocks: api.backed.fi).
mainnetMint and devnetTestMint are left empty on purpose: both must be resolved and verified
at setup time and written back by scripts/setup-devnet.ts. Never hand-write a mint here.
benchmark.coreFeedId is the 32-byte Pyth Core ID; a Terminal/Lazer id such as 1435 or 922 is
NOT a Core id and must never appear. Every Arena shares this one benchmark, which is what lets
a match pair any two Arenas: players may stake different tokens, and the creator fixes both
amounts and both USDC strikes up front, so no token ever needs a price the program trusts.

arenas.note: Built end to end first, per the schedule.
Tokenized public stock (Apple xStock). Benchmark stays TSLA: the Pyth trial does not entitle AAPL.
